reading.action: Smith a crude heavy MACE at the cistern camp — stone floor anvil, cold river-stone hammer, cistern quench, Ember + brazier forge. Consumes Burning Anger (bar -> haft), Sentry pauldron (steel -> head), plate scrap. Goal: heavy blunt instrument, head securely joined.

smith.note: SOLID crude mace (7-13 band). Heating was a given (t47 ember forge-heat); the roll governed the crude-tool JOIN + heft. Head well-seated and forge-joined, good blunt mass. New craft SKILL emerges: Smithing Novice 1. Internal atk ~6 (NOT shown — fog).

reading.result: SOLID crude MACE forged. A dense forged head (fused Sentry-pauldron steel + plate scrap) welded onto the Burning-Anger iron bar as haft; head well-seated, brutal blunt weapon, mundane metal (no binding; re-bindable later via Essence Infusion). CONSUMES Burning Anger + Sentry pauldron + scrap (he traded his only armor for weapon mass, by choice). River-stone hammer RETAINED. SKILL EMERGES: Smithing Novice 1 (new). EQUIP: finishes holding it -> wielded; equipment migrated to ESO 12-slot, mainHand = the mace (internal atk 6, fog-hidden). Cold Revenge remains charging in the cistern (his cold spare). COST: long hot forge work Focus 88 -> 55 (-33), Stamina 65 -> 42 (-23), minor burns HP 70 -> 67 (-3). NO affinity tick (craft, not absorption). STOP at his decision point. NO assumed next action. No reset.
